build_layoutlmv3_tokenizer: build a LayoutLMv3 tokenizer with custom vocab, merges, and special token bounding boxes
encode_text_with_boxes: encode pretokenized text with bounding boxes and word labels for document understanding tasks
batch_encode_sequences: batch encode multiple sequences with boxes and optional word labels for token classification
pad_encoded_inputs: pad encoded inputs to a maximum length with bounding boxes and labels on left or right side
build_inputs_special_tokens: build model inputs from token sequences by concatenating and adding RoBERTa-style special tokens
